modelName: Benelli Super Black Eagle Scope Mount
modelDescription: The Benelli Super Black Eagle has quickly become a cult classic among discriminating shooters worldwide. This is one shotgun that everybody would like to have. If you do have it, what can you do to improve its versatility? An ASM-18 Talon Aimtech scope/electronic sight mounting system will do the trick. You will NOT believe how good this mount works and looks. Take only 2-3 minutes to install and all necessary hardware and tools are provided. Do yourself a favor, if you are going to mount a scope or electronic sight, get yourself some 21st century technology to do it with, get an Aimtech ASM-18 Talon Mount.
